summary.zh: 区域天气地图上的城市

detail.en: Find Singapore using this Natural Earth city point. Wind and rain readings come from the surrounding regional grids, rather than a city weather station.
detail.zh: 这个 Natural Earth 城市点帮助找到新加坡。风和雨的读数来自周围的区域格网，并非市内气象站。
